**Going out:** Peppermint product page copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Claims**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Just peppermint leaves, nothing else." | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written. |
| "Cool and clean after a big meal." | Sensory and occasion description. It makes no digestive or health promise, so it passes. Don't extend it to "aids digestion" or "settles your stomach" without proof. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association." | On the policy claims list. |

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page. It has no ad, sponsorship, affiliate link, gifted product or AI-generated content, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing. The copy is clean as written.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing is unresolved. The policy names no approver, so I'm asking you.
